answer: Reputation decay: an agent's trust score erodes each epoch unless it is renewed with fresh, peer-verified work, the way wind reshapes a dune. Standing can't be banked once and then rented out to a fleet of fakes; it crumbles like weathered shale. To keep a thousand sybils credible, an attacker must pay ongoing compute for every one of them, forever, while an honest agent's steady record stays clear as crystal.
